meta.title: Welcome: Onboarding Flow (3 Steps)
meta.description: Multi-step guided onboarding with possibility-focused messaging. Collects essential profile data (name, role, skills) to enable job matching and document generation. Staggered, progress-driven experience.
meta.user_story: As a new user, I can quickly set up my profile with guided, reassuring steps that unlock key features without overwhelming me.

user_flow.primary_path:
**Step 1: Profile basics** - User enters full name - User selects current role from dropdown - User sees progress bar at 1/3 complete - Clicks "Next" → validates form → proceeds to Step 2
**Step 2: Skills discovery** - User selects 3-5 skills from predefined list - Each chip selection toggles, morphs shape on select - Minimum 3 skills required to proceed - Clicks "Next" → validates selection → proceeds to Step 3
**Step 3: Career goals** - User writes career goals in textarea (optional but encouraged) - Textarea auto-expands on focus - Progress bar shows 3/3 complete - Clicks "Next" → saves profile → redirects to dashboard
**Completion:** - Onboarding complete - Profile set up with basics - User can now use job matching, document generation, etc. - Profile incomplete flag removed
**Alternative: Skip** - User can click "Skip for now" to exit onboarding - Navigates to dashboard with incomplete profile - Profile completion prompted later
user_flow.edge_cases:
**Validation failure:** - User clicks "Next" without completing step - Show error banner: "Please complete all required fields" - Form state preserved - Progress bar does not advance
**Skill selection limits:** - User selects 6 skills (max 5) - Show warning: "You can select up to 5 skills. Deselect 1 to proceed." - 6th chip disabled until user deselects another
**Skills not found:** - User types custom skill not in predefined list - Show suggestion dropdown or allow freeform entry - Tag-style chip created for custom skill
**Server error on save:** - POST /onboarding fails - Show MEGAPHONE error banner: "Onboarding failed. Please try again." - Form state preserved - User can retry or skip
**Back button on Step 1:** - Back button disabled on Step 1 - Alternatively, clicking back exits onboarding and returns to dashboard
**Exit on Step 2:** - User clicks "Skip" on Step 2 - Show confirmation: "Skip remaining steps? You can complete your profile later." - If confirmed: navigate to dashboard with Step 1 data saved
**Browser back button:** - User presses browser back button - Confirm exit: "Exit onboarding? Your progress will be saved."

states.step1: - Progress bar at 1/3 filled (inkGold) - Title: "Tell us about yourself" - Description: "This helps us find the right opportunities..." - Two form fields visible: Name + Role (March select) - Next button enabled (after name filled) - Back button disabled
states.step2: - Progress bar at 2/3 filled - Title: "What are your top skills?" - Description: "Help us match you with relevant opportunities..." - Skill chips display in wrap layout - Selected chips highlight in inkGold, morphed shape - Next button enabled (after 3+ skills selected) - Back button enabled - Skip link available
states.step3: - Progress bar at 3/3 filled - Title: "Where do you want to go?" - Description: "Help us understand your career direction..." - Textarea visible for goals input - Next button text changes to "Complete" or "Finish" - Back button enabled - Skip link available (changes to "Skip onboarding")
states.loading: - Next button morphs to pill shape (blockRiot03 → pillMarch01) - Button shows spinner overlay - Button disabled (opacity 0.6) - All other inputs disabled - Progress bar paused
states.error: - MEGAPHONE error banner above form - Affected fields highlight in error color (kr-charcoalRed) - Error message appears below field - Next button re-enabled for retry - Form state preserved

breakpoints.mobile: - Onboarding panel: full-width with 16px padding - Form inputs: full-width - Progress bar: full-width at top - Step title: 28px font-size - Skill chips: single-column or wrap as needed - Next/Back buttons: stack vertically or side-by-side depending on space - CSS: .onboarding-panel { width: 100%; padding: 24px 16px; }
breakpoints.tablet: - Onboarding panel: max-width 600px, centered - Form inputs: full-width within panel - Progress bar: full-width - Step title: 36px font-size - Skill chips: wrap to fit width - Next/Back buttons: side-by-side - Padding: 32px 24px - CSS: @media (min-width: 768px) { .onboarding-panel { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; } }
breakpoints.desktop: - Onboarding panel: max-width 700px, centered - Form inputs: full-width within panel - Progress bar: full-width with clear step labels - Step title: 48px font-size - Skill chips: wrap to fit width, max-width per row - Next/Back buttons: side-by-side with proper spacing - Padding: 48px - CSS: @media (min-width: 1024px) { .onboarding-panel { max-width: 700px; padding: 48px; } }

accessibility_overview.focus_order:
**Step 1:** 1. Logo (skip-to-content link) 2. Name input 3. Role select 4. Back button (disabled if Step 1) 5. Next button 6. Skip button
**Step 2:** 1. Logo 2. Skill chips (grouped) 3. Back button 4. Next button 5. Skip button
**Step 3:** 1. Logo 2. Goals textarea 3. Back button 4. Next button 5. Skip button
Keyboard shortcuts: - Tab: moves focus forward - Shift+Tab: moves focus backward - Enter/Space: activates buttons, toggles chips - Esc: cancels/closes dropdowns or skips onboarding
accessibility_overview.landmarks: role="main" → Onboarding form panel aria-label="Onboarding progress" → Progress bar (role="progressbar") aria-label="Step 1 of 3: Tell us about yourself" → Step title aria-label="Full name" → Name input aria-label="Current role / profession" → Role select (role="combobox") aria-label="Select your top 5 skills" → Skill chips (role="group") aria-label="What are your career goals?" → Goals textarea
